onboarding.welcomeBody: Simple reminders for the medicines your doctor prescribed.

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change this later in Settings.

profile.title: Who are the reminders for?
profile.subtitle: We'll use this name on your screens. It stays on this phone.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Add your first medicine to start getting reminders.

disclaimer.title: Important
disclaimer.body: Tickdo reminds you to take medicines exactly as you enter them. It does not replace a doctor or pharmacist. It never suggests or changes doses or timings. Always follow your prescription, and ask your doctor or pharmacist if you are unsure.

today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Add a medicine and Tickdo will remind you at the times you choose.
today.setupBannerTitle: Reminders may not ring on time
today.setupBannerBody: Finish reminder setup so Tickdo can alert you.

medicines.title: Medicines
medicines.emptyBody: Add medicines by typing them in or by scanning a prescription.
medicines.limitBody: Upgrade to Tickdo Plus to add more.

add.title: Add a medicine
add.subtitle: Choose how you want to add it. Either way, you check and confirm before any reminder is set.
add.typeBody: Search the medicine name and enter the details from your prescription.
add.scanBody: Take a photo. Tickdo reads it on your phone and shows each medicine for you to check.
add.scanOffNote: Scanning is turned off in Settings.

form.name: Medicine name
form.notInList: Not in our medicine list. It will be saved exactly as you typed it.
form.listEmpty: The medicine list isn't installed yet, so type the full name as written on your prescription.
form.strengthHelp: As written on the strip or prescription.
form.timesHelp: Enter the times from your prescription or your doctor's advice.
form.duplicateTime: Two reminders have the same time
form.asNeededNote: As-needed medicines never get scheduled reminders. You can log a dose whenever you take one.
form.stockHelp: Optional. Used to warn you before you run out.
form.reviewBody: Compare with your prescription. Reminders start only after you confirm.

detail.stopConfirm: Stop reminders for this medicine? Its history stays.
detail.refillSoon: Less than 3 days left — time to refill

log.title: History
log.subtitle: Every dose and when it was recorded
log.emptyBody: When you mark doses taken or skipped, they appear here day by day.

setup.title: Reminder setup
setup.subtitle: A few phone settings make sure reminders ring on time, even when the phone is idle.
setup.notifBody: Needed to show reminders with Taken, Snooze and Skip buttons.
setup.exactBody: Android needs your permission for Tickdo to ring at the exact minute. Without it, reminders can be several minutes late. On the next screen, turn on "Allow setting alarms and reminders" for Tickdo.
setup.batteryTitle: Let Tickdo run in the background
setup.batteryBody: Your phone may stop apps to save battery, which can silence reminders.

xiaomi: Open Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Tickdo.
Tap Battery saver and choose No restrictions.
In the recent apps screen, long-press Tickdo and tap the lock icon.
realme: Open Settings → Apps → App management → Tickdo.
Tap Battery usage and turn on Allow background activity and Allow auto launch.
In the recent apps screen, tap the menu on Tickdo and choose Lock.
vivo: Open Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management.
Find Tickdo and choose Allow high background power consumption.
Open i Manager → App manager → Autostart manager and turn on Tickdo.
samsung: Open Settings → Battery → Background usage limits and make sure Tickdo is not in Sleeping or Deep sleeping apps.

notif.channelDosesDescription: Alerts at the times you set for your medicines
notif.title: Time for {{name}}
notif.testBody: If you can see and hear this, reminders are working.
notif.refillBody: About {{days}} days left at your current schedule.

settings.title: Settings
settings.testSent: A test reminder will appear in about 5 seconds.
settings.privacyMissing: The privacy policy link will be added before release.
settings.deleteAllHint: Removes everything from this phone and our server

delete.title: Delete all data
delete.body: This permanently deletes your medicines, reminders, history and scans from this phone, and your account and shared data from our server. This cannot be undone.
delete.serverSkipped: No account, so nothing was stored on our server
delete.serverFailed: Could not reach our server. Your phone data is deleted; please try again when online to delete server data.
delete.finished: All your data has been deleted.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.limitReached: You've reached the free plan limit.

scanSettings.title: Prescription scanning
scanSettings.body: When on, you can photograph a prescription and Tickdo reads it on your phone. You always check every medicine before it is saved. Adding by typing always works.
scanSettings.privacy: Photos never leave your phone. Each photo is deleted as soon as you finish checking it, or after 7 days at the latest.

scan.title: Scan prescription
scan.warningBody: Reading prescriptions, especially handwritten ones, can be wrong. Compare every medicine, strength and time with the paper before confirming.
scan.captureHint: Place the prescription flat in good light and fit it inside the frame.
scan.permissionBody: Tickdo uses the camera only to photograph your prescription. The photo stays on your phone.
scan.tooDark: The photo is too dark. Turn on more light or the torch, then try again.
scan.tooBlurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady and make sure the text is sharp.
scan.nothingFound: Tickdo could not read any text from this photo.
scan.nothingFoundBody: Try a sharper photo in better light, or add the medicines by typing.
scan.noneRecognisedBody: The lines read from the photo are below. Add the medicines by typing them in.
scan.reviewSubtitle: Compare each card with your prescription. Only medicines you confirm are saved.
scan.unrecognisedBody: These lines did not match a medicine. If one is a medicine, add it by typing.
scan.discardBody: The photo will be deleted and nothing will be saved.
scan.limitReached: Free plan limit reached. Confirmed medicines beyond {{limit}} need Tickdo Plus.

plus.title: Tickdo Plus
plus.short: Unlimited medicines, caregiver sharing, refill alerts
plus.headline: More help, for the whole family
plusItems: Refill alerts before you run out
plus.unavailable: Purchases are not available right now. Please try again later.
plus.notConfigured: Purchases are not set up in this build yet.
plus.terms: Billed through Google Play. Cancel anytime in Play Store subscriptions.

account.title: Account
account.intro: An account is optional. You need one only to share your dose history with a caregiver. Reminders work without it.
account.codeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
account.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up in this build yet.
account.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.

caregiver.title: Caregiver sharing
caregiver.short: Let a family member see your doses
caregiver.intro: Invite one caregiver. They can see your dose history and get an alert if a dose is more than 60 minutes late.
caregiver.needsAccount: Sign in first to share with a caregiver.
caregiver.needsPlus: Caregiver sharing is part of Tickdo Plus.
caregiver.invited: Invite sent to {{phone}}. They need to install Tickdo and sign in with this number.
caregiver.removeConfirm: Stop sharing your doses with this caregiver?
caregiver.inviteFrom: {{name}} invited you to be their caregiver
caregiver.noneShared: Nobody has shared with you yet.
caregiver.overdueAlert: {{name}}: a dose is more than 60 minutes late
caregiver.whatIsShared: Shared: medicine names, dose times, and whether each dose was taken, skipped or missed. Not shared: photos, scans, notes.
